subject: Ant mortality is not one thing: size predicts lifespan, but circadian niche and lineage govern aging and heat death
script: Aging isn't a decay sentence; it is a bio-energetic signal written in your cellular voltage and autophagy pathways. A new biophysics study just dropped on 'Ant mortality is not one thing: size predicts lifespan, but circadian niche and lineage govern aging and heat death'. A new study of 18 Australian ant species shows that body size predicts how long workers live, but not how they age or how they die from heat. The findings challenge size-based vulnerability indices and point to circadian. The science is clear: when you align your physical habits with cellular light, longevity becomes effortless.
